verdict.rationale: Working Copy has its own programmatic surface: a documented x-callback-url scheme protected by a secret key, plus Shortcuts actions. Nothing in the evidence shows this surface matches the UI, and it is documented only as prose with deep-link examples, with no schema, versioning or test mode; the OpenAPI probes returned 404. Missing for 10: evidence of UI-to-API parity (e.g. hunk staging, conflict resolution, commit rewriting, tags, stash via the API), a machine-readable API reference, versioning/deprecation policy, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Commands that change data or read content out of Working Copy are protected by a secret key
Working Copy supports automation through the Shortcuts app where files and other data can flow between actions.
Use Shortcuts and x-callback-url for automation.
